definition: The student created or updated documentation or another reusable knowledge source, or explicitly shared implementation knowledge with others.
positive_criteria: Describes writing or updating a README, guide, technical notes, API documentation, or similar knowledge source
Describes a walkthrough, handover, tutorial, or recorded explanation that shares useful knowledge
negative_criteria: Explicitly reports leaving needed documentation or knowledge transfer unfinished
Mentions using documentation without creating, updating, or sharing knowledge
